data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 713.183m. The syndicate's gross claims development table for prior underwriting years (2011-2015) shows negligible movement overall (effectively flat on a gross basis). The movement note discloses components (a net claims strengthening/release line and releases of risk margin and loss adjustment expense) which aggregate to a net release figure; however the gross claims development triangle indicates no material gross prior-year strengthening or release. Key causal issues discussed in the report include the Ogden discount rate change and ongoing inflationary pressures on claim costs.
raw_causal_phrases: Ogden discount rate announcement on 27 February 2017
Further inflation in claim severities and frequencies

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: the gross claims development triangle (gross of reinsurance) was used to calculate prior-year movement and shows effectively no movement for underwriting years 2011-2015 (hence a flat / zero gross PYD). A separate movement note provides totals (Total GBP 9,560k) which appear to combine net claims movement and releases of risk margin and LAE; that note is presented on a net or mixed basis, so the triangle was preferred as the gross source per methodology rules. Reinsurance to close (RITC) activity and reinsurance recoverables appear elsewhere in the accounts and can distort some tables; figures were taken from the stated gross triangle (values shown in the notes are in GBP 000 and have been converted to millions).
